defmodule MyApp.ShapesTest do
  use ExUnit.Case

  test "inline end" do MyApp.Admission.admit(1) end
  test "after inline end" do
    assert MyApp.Admission.admit(2)
  end

  test "keyword do", do: assert(MyApp.Admission.admit(3))

  test "keyword do spread",
    do:
      assert(MyApp.Admission.admit(4))

  test "with context", %{value: value} do
    MyApp.Admission.admit(value)
  end
end
